notes: Original EffectCraft image utility presets (MIT OR Apache-2.0), written from scratch on EffectCraft channel, tint, and color effects.

presets.name: Alpha from Lightness (Unmult)
presets.description: Extracts alpha channel transparency from luminance (black backgrounds become transparent).

presets.name: Invert Alpha
presets.description: Inverts the layer's alpha transparency channel while leaving RGB color untouched.

presets.name: Subtle Vignette
presets.description: Soft perimeter darkening using a subtle tint blend.
